snippet.title: Turbo Carnage // Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3932930/Turbo_Carnage/

Turbo Carnage is a fast‑paced arena survival game. Smash through clowns with deadly vehicles, fire high‑powered weapons, and call airstrikes. Play solo or join friends in online co‑op against endless, escalating waves.

Developed by 
Haylaz Games
